REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56784  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Board of Examiners, Appeals and
  Condemnation meetings of Monday, September 15 and October 13, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56785  Recommendation to receive supporting documentation into the record, conclude
  the hearing, deny the appellant's appeal, and confirm that the subject property
  located at 1508 Orange Avenue, Long Beach, CA, 90813, meets the definition of
  vacant lot as stated in the Long Beach Municipal Code 18.29.070(C), that the
  appellant is the owner of the property, and that the appellant is liable for the annual
  vacant lot fee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56791  Recommendation to receive and file Manager’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

CALL TO ORDER

At 1:37 PM, Chair Lipson called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Askin, Enriquez, Hower, Lipson

Commissioners Absent: Hoops, Powers

Also present: Angel Arredondo, Code Enforcement Bureau Manager, Scott Baldwin, Acting Code
Enforcement Officer, Elbert DuBose, Clerk Typist III, Eli Ben-Shmuel, Deputy City Attorney,
Karen Baldwin, Senior City Clerk Analyst, Rosa Garibay, City Clerk Assistant.

The Board objected and unanimously voted to declare Member Powers’ absence from the meeting as
unexcused.

 Member Hoops is excused from the meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Vice Chair Askin led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56784  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Board of Examiners, Appeals and
  Condemnation meetings of Monday, September 15 and October 13, 2025.

  A motion was made by Member Hower, seconded by Vice Chair Askin, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4 Askin, Enriquez, Hower, Lipson
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None

2.  25-56785  Recommendation to receive supporting documentation into the record, conclude
  the hearing, deny the appellant's appeal, and confirm that the subject property
  located at 1508 Orange Avenue, Long Beach, CA, 90813, meets the definition of
  vacant lot as stated in the Long Beach Municipal Code 18.29.070(C), that the
  appellant is the owner of the property, and that the appellant is liable for the annual
  vacant lot fee.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Askin, seconded by Member Enriquez, to
  receive supporting documentation into the record, conclude the hearing,
  grant the appellant's appeal, and find that the subject property located at 1508
  Orange Avenue, Long Beach, CA, 90813, does not meet the definition of
  vacant lot as stated in the Long Beach Municipal Code 18.29.070(C), find that
  the appellant is the owner of the property, and find that the appellant is not
  liable for the annual vacant lot monitoring fee. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  3  Askin, Enriquez, Lipson
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 1  Hower
  Absent: 2  Powers, Hoops
